evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' carries high-arousal urgency to purge information, a forceful directive register.
Imperative 'Remove all' signals urgent, high-arousal insistence on erasure — activated-negative in its forceful demand.
Flat declarative delivered as settled fact, low-arousal and negative in its function of negating prior claims.
